readout_other: Resting-state fMRI DMN-CEN connectivity; ES-16 Equanimity Scale (acceptance); meditation sitting time; sensation questionnaire
direction_notes: Intended suppressive protocol; DMN-CEN connectivity decreased (decoupling) in the active group and increased slightly in sham from pre to post the two-week training.
safety_notes: No adverse events reported; post-session sensation questionnaire; 40 of 56 active and 5 of 32 sham sessions had participants report hearing the tFUS.

exposures.label: Active tFUS to PCC during meditation, four sessions

timing.protocol_description: 5% duty cycle; stimulus pattern 5 seconds on, 10 seconds off for 5 minutes; delivered by hand-held transducer during meditation; PRF 1000 Hz inferred by authors from audible tone.
